title: Small presheaf categories are locally finitely presentable
statement: Fix universes $\mathcal U\in\mathcal V$ [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $C$ be a $\mathcal U$-small ordinary category. The category $\operatorname{Fun}(C^{\mathrm{op}},\operatorname{Set}_{\mathcal U})$ of set-valued presheaves, with natural transformations as morphisms and formed in $\mathcal V$, is locally finitely presentable relative to $\mathcal U$: it has all $\mathcal U$-small colimits and a $\mathcal U$-small family $G$ of objects such that every presheaf is a $\mathcal U$-small filtered colimit of objects of $G$ and $\operatorname{Hom}(g,-)$ preserves $\mathcal U$-small filtered colimits for every $g\in G$. Colimits and filteredness use [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit].
